subject: Observability Handoff — Solstice Health: playbook, dashboards & escalation routing
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@solsticehealth.com>, Elena Gomez <elena@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability Handoff — Solstice Health: playbook, dashboards & escalation routing

Hi Samir / Elena —

Great to kick this off. Per our discovery call, attaching a first-pass handoff bundle so your SREs and our implementation team can align on the staging rollout this month. High-level ask: confirm the 2-week staging window starting 2028-04-10 and we will schedule the instrumentation pairing sessions (dashboards + tracing hooks) during week one.

What’s included in this bundle (attachments):
- Solstice-obs-runbook-v1.md — runbook draft with ownership and step-by-step recovery play for the three top incidents we saw in the audit.
- dashboards/solstice-summary.dash — proposed summary dashboard (error rates, 95th latency, token consumption by route).
- tracing-hooks-spec.md — naming conventions, span annotations, and RPC shim points for your service mesh.
- alert-routing-mapping.xlsx — mapping of alert -> severity -> PagerDuty layer suggestion.

Immediate asks for you:
1) Confirm staging start date (we recommended 2028-04-10).
2) Add primary PagerDuty escalation contact and any suppressed windows (payroll / batch jobs).
3) Share any internal SLO definitions we should map to alerts (e.g., 99th latency for /generate).

Proposed next steps (we can adjust):
- 2028-04-10: instrumentation pairing session (90m) — Rishi + Ben + Solstice SREs
- 2028-04-12: dashboard walkthrough and alert tuning (60m) — Laura + Solstice product ops
- 2028-04-17: war-room cutover checklist and dry-run

If that timeline works, I’ll create the calendar invites and a HubSpot activity and send the DocuSign for the final onboarding addendum.

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

---
Attachment stubs: Solstice-obs-runbook-v1.md (text), dashboards/solstice-summary.dash (dash file), tracing-hooks-spec.md (text), alert-routing-mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Apr 2028 13:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability Handoff — Solstice Health: playbook, dashboards & escalation routing

Rishi — looping in a couple of implementation specifics I want on the checklist before we go live:

- Tracing: prefer "service.operation" span names and include "customer.request_id" tag for trace linking. See tracing-hooks-spec.md for examples.
- Dashboard: add a ratio tile for "error budget burn" (rolling 24h) to help SRE decide suppression vs. paging.
- Alerts: propose noise gating for low-traffic routes by setting a min-call threshold to avoid noisy pages.
- Runbooks: add explicit rollback commands for the top 2 incident classes; include a short-form runbook header with PagerDuty escalation phone number and runbook owner.

I’ll draft the calendar invites for the pairing sessions and include a short pre-read for Solstice SREs. Laura — can you confirm availability for the 04/12 dashboard walkthrough?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Samir Patel <samir@solsticehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Gomez <elena@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability Handoff — Solstice Health: playbook, dashboards & escalation routing

Thanks Rishi — this looks good and the 04/10 start works for our team. A few clarifications from our side:

- PagerDuty: we want initial pages to be to our on-call (level 1) then escalate to platform SRE (level 2) and then to engineering manager only for P1s. I’ll share the exact PD service IDs tomorrow.
- Suppression windows: payroll jobs run daily at 02:00–03:00 PT; we prefer to suppress low severity alerts during that hour.
- Compliance question: do you retain trace payloads longer than 7 days on the hosted API? We need clarity for our security audit.

Elena (cc) — I’ve added you to confirm PD contacts and internal SLOs.

Samir
Samir Patel
Director of Platform Reliability, Solstice Health
samir@solsticehealth.com

Subject: Re: Observability Handoff — Solstice Health: playbook, dashboards & escalation routing

Samir / Elena — thanks — this is all clear. Quick plan & owners to close this out before 04/10: 

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Share PagerDuty service IDs and primary on-call contact (Samir) — ETA: 2028-04-03 (received)
- Finalize runbook — Ben to update Solstice-obs-runbook-v1.md with PD phone and rollback steps — ETA: 2028-04-05
- Instrumentation pairing session invite (Rishi) — calendar invite sent for 2028-04-10 09:00 PT (90m)
- Dashboard tuning session (Laura) — 2028-04-12 11:00 PT (60m)
- Compliance: retention & trace payloads — short answer: hosted traces use a 7-day default retention for full payloads; we can configure trimmed spans to be kept longer under Private/Dedicated. I’ll loop in Security for a formal statement if you need SOC/BIS documentation.

Links & next steps:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HD-7683021 (I created an onboarding activity and set next task: 'Instrumentation pairing')
- Drive folder with pre-reads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDEFghi
- DocuSign onboarding addendum (sent): https://www.docusign.com/solstice-obsv-sign — Elisa from procurement should see it for e-signature.

Ben / Laura — please attach the updated runbook and the final dashboard JSON in the Drive folder by 2028-04-05 so Solstice can review before the pairing session. I’ll also add a short bullet list to the runbook about alert suppression windows and noise gating thresholds.

Thanks — looking forward to the pairing session.

Rishi
